name: AI Chips
seo_intro: AI Chips tracks semiconductor and accelerator names tied to AI compute. Sample tickers: AMD, ARM, INTC, NVDA — see the table for the full fixture list.

theme_thesis.thesis: Fixture sample: AI accelerators and foundry capacity remain the binding constraint for frontier-model training and inference scale-out.
bull_case: Hyperscaler capex cycles still favor GPU-class silicon and HBM supply.
Second-source and custom ASIC programs broaden the revenue pool beyond one vendor.
bear_case: Export controls and packaging bottlenecks can stall unit growth even when demand is strong.
Model efficiency gains could slow the marginal chip-intensity of new workloads.
